body.name: dsh-web v0.4.4
body.body:
本次发布把家族适配的官方 SDK cohort 推进到 `0.2.0-rc.1`，让工坊商店复用官方插件面板，重做任务看板的排期时区、运行目标与治理，并带上四个卫星仓的 `0.4.4` 内容。

> **重要变更**：本版本没有需要手工迁移的改动，没有重命名任何已持久化的标识符、线协议字段或 profile 格式。任务看板的排期规则新增可选的 IANA 时区字段，旧规则缺少该字段时按宿主时区执行；任务的 `/goal` 开关只在关闭时落盘，字段缺省即开启。
> **宿主下限提升到 `>=0.2.0-rc.1`**：家族全部包与插件脚手架声明 `dsh.engines.dsh >=0.2.0-rc.1` 与同名 host peer，插件管理器在安装与更新时读取该下限。仍运行 `0.1.7-rc.2`（npm `latest`）的宿主低于该下限，请在插件管理器里更新家族包之前先把 DSH 本体升级到 `0.2.0-rc.1`（npm `next` 频道）。
> 四个卫星仓（皮肤中心、宠物、社区插件索引、预设中心）已先发布 `0.4.4`，本仓随后打 tag，聚合包按 semver 消费它们。

### 新功能

- [task-board] 每条排期规则各自持有 IANA 时区，未设置时按宿主时区执行
- [task-board] 任务可以指定运行目标（agent preset），新建对话框按区域拆分
- [task-board] 任务运行以 dsh 内置 `/goal` 启动，持续工作到目标达成
- [task-board] 看板无法观测到的运行中卡片可以由操作者强制结算，回到待办后可以重跑
- [dsh-market] 工坊商店复用官方插件面板，不再自带一套商店界面

### 修复

- [web] 修复 issue 批次 1743、1744、1745、1746、1748 与 1751
- [web] 修复 issue 批次 1724、1730、1732、1740 与 1742
- [plugin-manager] 应用自带 profile 的安装与移除交给官方插件管理器执行
- [task-board] 团队运行由 Lead 治理，不再静默停在待办
- [task-board] 同一次运行内的协作者名称保持唯一
- [task-board] 恢复预设供给，降低客户端渲染与血缘门控的开销
- [client] 修复技能中心的布局注入、使用量页的 0.1.7 设置与任务看板的围栏报错
- [scripts] `link-profile` 拒绝链接无法加载的卫星检出

### 其他改动

- [sdk] 官方 cohort 推进到 `0.2.0-rc.1`：下限、host peer、README 徽章与 CI/发布的挂载 pin 一起移动
- [skins] 卫星 gitlink 与市场产物跟随皮肤中心的设置行修复、orca-link 顶部内边距重测与新皮肤
- [market] 市场列出 porco-rosso、last-exile 与 white-snake 三个新皮肤
- [shared] 移除已死的共享产物（`mobileBundle` 与无人读取的同步副本）并对齐引用
- [test] 两个新增的 BDD 用例改用角色化标题

---

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release advances the family's adapted SDK cohort to `0.2.0-rc.1`, makes the Workshop store reuse the official plugin surfaces, reworks the task board's schedule zones, run targets and governance, and ships the `0.4.4` content of the four satellite repositories.

> **Important change**: no manual migration is needed, and no persisted identifier, wire-protocol field or profile format was renamed. A task-board schedule rule gains an optional IANA time zone and falls back to the host zone when the field is absent; a task's `/goal` opt-in is stored only when it is off, so an absent field means on.
> **The host floor moves to `>=0.2.0-rc.1`**: every family package and the plugin scaffold declare `dsh.engines.dsh >=0.2.0-rc.1` and the matching host peer, and the plugin manager reads that floor at install and update time. A host still on `0.1.7-rc.2` (npm `latest`) sits below it, so upgrade DSH itself to `0.2.0-rc.1` (the npm `next` channel) before updating the family through the plugin manager.
> The four satellite repositories (skin center, pet, community plugin index, preset center) have already published `0.4.4`; this repository tags afterwards and the aggregate consumes them by semver range.

### New Features

- [task-board] Each schedule rule carries its own IANA time zone and follows the host zone when none is set
- [task-board] A task can name its run target (an agent preset), and the create dialog is split into regions
- [task-board] A task run starts with dsh's built-in `/goal` and keeps working until the goal completes
- [task-board] An operator can settle a running card the board cannot observe; it returns to todo and can be run again
- [dsh-market] The Workshop store reuses the official plugin surfaces instead of shipping its own store UI

### Bug Fixes

- [web] Resolve the open issue batch 1743, 1744, 1745, 1746, 1748 and 1751
- [web] Resolve the open issue batch 1724, 1730, 1732, 1740 and 1742
- [plugin-manager] Installing into and removing from an application-owned profile go through the official plugin manager
- [task-board] Team runs are governed by the Lead and no longer stall silently in pending
- [task-board] Every teammate keeps a unique name inside one run
- [task-board] The preset feed is restored and client render and lineage-gate costs are cut
- [client] Fix the skill-explorer layout injection, the usage page's 0.1.7 settings and the task board's fence error
- [scripts] `link-profile` refuses to link a satellite checkout that cannot be loaded

### Other Changes

- [sdk] The official cohort moves to `0.2.0-rc.1`: the floor, the host peer, the README badges and the CI/release mount pin move together
- [skins] The satellite gitlinks and market artifacts follow the skin center's settings-row fix, the orca-link top-inset re-measure and the new skins
- [market] The market lists the new porco-rosso, last-exile and white-snake skins
- [shared] Dead shared artifacts (the `mobileBundle` and the sync copies nobody read) are removed and their references realigned
- [test] The two new BDD cases get role-led titles

</details>

body.name: dsh-web v0.4.3
body.body:
本次发布把家族面板整体搬到宿主的原生布局席位，把自更新拆成独立的插件行，并把皮肤、宠物、社区插件索引与预设中心四个卫星仓的 `0.4.3` 内容一起带上。

> **重要变更**：本版本没有需要手工迁移的改动，没有重命名任何已持久化的标识符、线协议字段或 profile 格式；设置页变化的是渲染席位，不涉及存储。宿主下限保持 `>=0.1.7-rc.2`，请先升级 DSH 本体再安装或升级本版本。
> 四个卫星仓（皮肤中心、宠物、社区插件索引、预设中心）已先发布 `0.4.3`，本仓随后打 tag，聚合包按 semver 消费它们。
> **自更新入口独立成包**：原先挂在远程访问插件里的自更新界面移到了 `@linxin666/dsh-update`，并作为独立 bundle 行 `web-ui-update` 进入聚合包。聚合安装会在升级时自动带上这一行；只单独安装 `@linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui` 的 profile 需要另外安装该包，才能继续看到自更新入口。

### 新功能

- [dsh-update] 自更新拆成独立的插件行：关掉远程访问不再连带关掉自更新入口，探测 npm 上的新版本并在原地跑所属 profile 的更新
- [shared] 所有家族面板统一渲染到宿主的原生布局席位，技能中心与任务看板共用同一套席位契约
- [panels] 原生面板行的图标带上 `data-dsh-panel-entry` 身份锚点：皮肤（L2 契约）据此把样式落到自己的侧栏行，宿主侧栏不提供逐条目钩子
- [ssh] 终端会话可以超出打开它的视图继续存活
- [liangshen] V4.1 Flash 的评测口径与默认值按实测收敛

### 修复

- [plugin-manager] 应用自带的 profile 走官方插件管理器更新
- [settings] 家族设置卡片绑定到宿主实际服务的那条 profile 条目；使用量与远程访问的设置页恢复可写
- [remote-web-ui] 运行中的隧道按公网 URL 监督；LAN 访问绑定宿主启动的 profile；脚行席位不再挤坏设置行
- [shared] 上一次挂载尚未释放时被拒绝的家族挂载不再丢失，持有者退出后自动重放
- [dsh-web-all] 分组行与行操作下移动端抽屉保持展开；家族装饰下 macOS 窗口仍可拖动
- [task-board] 桌面外壳的 browser-auth cookie 在围栏处被接受
- [release] 根别名包的版本跟着发布 tag 一起走

### 其他改动

- [market] 市场产物跟随卫星仓 gitlink 更新到皮肤中心的选择器修复与重新锚定的皮肤行
- [skins] 皮肤行重新锚定到原生面板列表（`future-window`、`orca-link`、`wallpaper-exclusive`、`whale-fantasy`）
- [scripts] `link-profile` 的范围判断改用真正的 semver 比较
- [docs] CONTRIBUTING 要求提交卫星仓 submodule 变更；补记家族原生席位的归属笔记
- [test] 桌面页规格不再杀掉自己的 worker

---

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release moves every family panel onto the host's native layout seats, splits self-update into its own plugin row, and ships the `0.4.3` content of the four satellite repositories (skin center, pet, community plugin index, preset center).

> **Important change**: no manual migration is needed, and no persisted identifier, wire-protocol field or profile format was renamed; what changes on the settings pages are render seats, not stored data. The host floor stays at `>=0.1.7-rc.2`, so upgrade DSH itself before installing or updating this version.
> The four satellite repositories have already published `0.4.3`; this repository tags afterwards and the aggregate consumes them by semver range.
> **The self-update surface is now its own package**: it moved out of the remote-access plugin into `@linxin666/dsh-update` and enters the aggregate as its own bundle row `web-ui-update`. Aggregate installs pick the row up on upgrade; a profile that installs `@linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui` alone needs this package too to keep the update trigger.

### New Features

- [dsh-update] Self-update becomes its own plugin row: turning remote access off no longer takes the update trigger away; it probes npm for newer releases and runs the owning profile's update in place
- [shared] Every family panel renders through the host's native layout seats, with the skill center and the task board sharing one seat contract
- [panels] Native panel-row glyphs carry a `data-dsh-panel-entry` identity anchor so a skin (the L2 contract) can target its own sidebar row; the host sidebar stamps no per-entry hook of its own
- [ssh] A terminal session can outlive the view that opened it
- [liangshen] The V4.1 Flash evaluation and defaults settle on what the measurements show

### Bug Fixes

- [plugin-manager] An application-owned profile is updated through the official plugin manager
- [settings] Family settings cards bind to the profile entry the host actually serves, and the usage and remote-access settings pages are writable again
- [remote-web-ui] A running tunnel is supervised by its public URL, LAN access binds to the profile the host booted, and the foot-row seat no longer breaks the settings row
- [shared] A family mount refused while its previous holder still lived is no longer lost; it replays once the holder exits
- [dsh-web-all] The mobile drawer stays open for group rows and row actions, and the macOS window stays draggable under family decorations
- [task-board] The desktop shell's browser-auth cookie is accepted at the fence
- [release] The root alias bundle carries the release tag version

### Other Changes

- [market] The market artifacts follow the satellite gitlinks to the skin-center picker fix and the re-anchored skin rows
- [skins] Skin rows are re-anchored on the native panel list (`future-window`, `orca-link`, `wallpaper-exclusive`, `whale-fantasy`)
- [scripts] `link-profile` compares the relink range as real semver
- [docs] CONTRIBUTING requires committing satellite submodule changes, and the native-seat ownership note is recorded
- [test] The desktop page spec no longer kills its own worker

</details>

body.name: v0.4.2
body.body:
本次发布把全家桶迁移到官方 0.1.7-rc.2 cohort，并带来任务看板的子任务与 Agent Team 执行、桌面端移除与卫星仓拆分后的收尾。

> **重要变更**：本版本没有需要手工迁移的插件数据改动，但有两件事要先知道。
> 一是**宿主下限提高到 `0.1.7-rc.2`**：所有家族包声明 `dsh.engines.dsh >=0.1.7-rc.2`，请先升级 DSH 本体再安装或升级本版本。
> 二是**桌面端（Electron 应用及其打包 lane）已从本仓库移除**：桌面场景由官方 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端承接，本仓库不再产出桌面安装包。
> 皮肤中心、宠物、社区插件索引与预设中心四个卫星仓从本版本起与本仓发布同一个版本号 `0.4.2`；它们先发布，本仓随后打 tag，聚合包按 semver 消费它们。

### 新功能

- [task-board] 子任务、Agent 工具与 Agent Team 执行：看板支持父子任务与并发级联执行，新增八个模型可调用的看板工具，并支持以 Agent Team 方式执行（由 Host 为每个子任务拉起队友）
- [market] 市场内容改为经卫星仓 submodule 固定内容提交，构建读取 gitlink 指向的目录
- [scripts] `link-profile` 同时链接卫星包到本地 DSH profile

### 修复

- [remote-web-ui] 应用投放的每一类页面都不再落入配对围栏；LAN 必需提示同时指明两处设置位置
- [task-board] 失败的会话复用执行如实记录，并断言固定的 agent preset
- [client] 插件路由按文档相对路径投递，子路径部署不再拼错地址
- [dsh-web-all] 原地重载后家族页签与看板入口保持可用；带壳家族行改为可配置
- [usage] 余额探测限定在自身账号 origin
- [desktop] profile 重播种时保留每个插件的 bundle patch 文件（随桌面端移除一并退役）
- [market] 移除部署 lane 的部署后资产校验；边缘资产状态按实际重复状态判定并重试瞬时状态

### 其他改动

- [preset-center] 改为消费拆出的预设中心包，不再在本仓内置
- [scripts] PR 评审与皮肤/pet 流程指向卫星仓；退掉本仓不再服务的 renderer 路由与皮肤评审 lane
- [ci] 特权 workflow 只在规范仓库运行；路由 glob 与配置文档一致
- [test] 重录当前测试舰队实际测得的覆盖率基线；家族测试环境提供可用的 localStorage
- [docs] 补齐卫星仓关系、四仓措辞与发布准备说明

---

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release moves the family onto the official 0.1.7-rc.2 cohort and brings task-board subtasks with Agent Team execution, the removal of the desktop app, and the follow-through from the satellite-repository split.

> **Important change**: no manual plugin-data migration is needed, but two things change up front.
> First, the **host floor rises to `0.1.7-rc.2`**: every family package declares `dsh.engines.dsh >=0.1.7-rc.2`, so upgrade DSH itself before installing or updating this version.
> Second, the **Electron desktop application and its packaging lane have been removed from this repository**: desktop use is served by the official DeepSeek Harness desktop client, and this repository no longer produces desktop installers.
> From this release on, the four satellite repositories (skin center, pet, community plugin index, preset center) publish the same version `0.4.2` as this repository. They publish first and this repository tags afterwards, and the aggregate consumes them by semver range.

### New Features

- [task-board] Subtasks, agent tools and Agent Team runs: the board supports parent/child tasks with concurrent cascade execution, adds eight model-facing board tools, and can run a task as an Agent Team (the host spawns a teammate per subtask)
- [market] Market content is pinned through the satellite submodules, and the build reads the directories the gitlinks name
- [scripts] `link-profile` links the satellite packages into the local DSH profile too

### Bug Fixes

- [remote-web-ui] Every application-delivered page stays out of the pairing fence, and the LAN-required hint names both settings locations
- [task-board] Failed session-reuse executions are recorded honestly, and the pinned agent preset is asserted
- [client] Plugin routes post document-relative, so sub-path deployments no longer build the wrong address
- [dsh-web-all] Family surfaces and the board entry survive an in-place reload, and shelled family rows become configurable
- [usage] A provider balance probe is scoped to its own account origin
- [desktop] Every plugin bundle patch file survives a profile reseed (retired together with the desktop app)
- [market] The deploy lane drops its post-deploy asset verification, and the asset sweep judges edge statuses by what the edge repeats and retries transient ones

### Other Changes

- [preset-center] Consumes the extracted preset center package instead of carrying it here
- [scripts] PR review and the skin/pet flows point at the satellite repositories; the renderer route and skin-review lane this repository no longer serves are withdrawn
- [ci] Privileged workflows run only in the canonical repository, and the routing globs match the documented paths
- [test] The coverage baseline is re-recorded from what the current fleet measures, and the family test setups get a usable localStorage
- [docs] The satellite relationship, the four-repository wording and the release-preparation notes are brought up to date

</details>

body.name: dsh-web v0.4.1
body.body:
本次发布修复 0.4.0 的升级路径，共 1 项修复。

> **重要变更**：本版本没有需要手工迁移的改动，但**从 0.3.24 或更早版本升级的用户应当升到本版本**。0.4.0 声明的卫星依赖范围是 `^0.3.24`，升级时包管理器会保留锁文件里已经解析到的 `0.3.24`：那个构建仍然注入 0.1.7-rc.1 宿主已退役的 `settingsScope` 服务，皮肤中心、宠物与社区插件的浏览器半区会一直等它，因而永不激活。本版本把三个卫星依赖的下限提到 `^0.3.25`，锁文件不再满足新范围，升级时会重新解析到携带该迁移的 `0.3.25`。全新安装不受影响。

### 修复

- [aggregate] 卫星依赖下限提高到 `^0.3.25`，升级时不再保留 0.1.7-rc.1 迁移之前的卫星构建
- [aggregate] 在卫星行测试里钉住该下限：任何声明的范围都不得接受低于迁移版本的地板

---

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release fixes the 0.4.0 upgrade path. One bug fix.

> **Important change**: no manual migration is needed, but **anyone upgrading from 0.3.24 or earlier should move to this version**. 0.4.0 declared the satellite ranges as `^0.3.24`, and an upgrade keeps whatever version the lockfile already resolved, so the `0.3.24` build stayed installed: it still injects the `settingsScope` service the 0.1.7-rc.1 host retired, and the skin center, pet and community client halves wait for it forever and never activate. This release raises the three satellite floors to `^0.3.25`, so the lockfile no longer satisfies the new range and re-resolves the satellites to the `0.3.25` build that carries the migration. Fresh installs are unaffected.

### Bug Fixes

- [aggregate] raise the satellite dependency floors to `^0.3.25`, so an upgrade no longer keeps a satellite build from before the 0.1.7-rc.1 migration
- [aggregate] pin that floor in the satellite-rows lane: no declared range may admit a floor below the migration release

</details>

body.name: dsh-web v0.4.0
body.body:
本次发布共 118 个提交，是家族成员构成发生变化的 0.4.0：18 项新功能、37 项修复、63 项其他改动。

> **重要变更**：版本号从 0.3.x 进入 0.4.x，因为家族成员构成变了，但**没有需要手工迁移的破坏性改动**。皮肤集合、宠物插件与社区插件索引正式迁出为三个独立仓库并各自发版（本次三个仓库都发布了 `0.3.25`，修掉了 `0.3.x` 家族包在 0.1.7-rc.1 宿主上因仍注入已退役的 `settingsScope` 而无法激活的问题），本仓改为通过 npm 包内置它们。聚合包的行 id 与旧 subpath 导出（`./pet`、`./skin-center`、`./community-plugins`）保持不变，并以 tombstone 形式继续导出，旧 profile 仍可解析，不会抛 `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`。`dsh-doctor` 与 `dsh-tool-describe-image` 按所有者方向退出家族，两个包各自保留 tombstone subpath 导出，旧 profile 退化为惰性插件而不是启动失败。市场站不再从工作树读取皮肤/宠物内容与社区索引，改为按 `market-inputs.lock.json` 固定的提交拉取，并校验线上部署的资产。宠物、皮肤中心与社区索引自身的改动记录在这三个仓库的 release notes，不重复列在本篇。

### 新功能

- [aggregate] 把迁出的卫星插件挂载为 npm 外部行，旧 subpath 以 tombstone 保留
- [market] 固定皮肤/宠物内容与社区索引的来源提交，并校验线上部署资产
- [packages] 为每个家族插件提供独立列表图标
- [packages] 把 DSH 宿主声明为家族 peer 依赖
- [usage] 在侧边栏设置入口行下方新增可折叠的余额速览卡片
- [liangshen] 熔断阈值随推理强度自适应并新增灵敏度预设
- [liangshen] 在插件设置中暴露熔断阈值
- [liangshen] 默认 wire 改为 both，引入运行时熔断与事实账本（V4.1）
- [liangshen] 出厂预设呈现默认改为 ptc
- [liangshen] 限定巡检范围，并在人格纪律上强制主动收敛
- [market] 工坊的站外链接改用官方侧边栏浏览器打开
- [remote-web-ui] 面板名册在被拒绝的撤销请求下保持权威

### 修复

- [e2e] 家族 tarball 覆盖目录只覆盖本仓 workspace 构建的包
- [test] 容忍 `packages/skins` 根目录缺失（新克隆里它不存在）
- [ci] 卫星依赖按语义化范围而非精确版本解析

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release contains 20 new features, 16 bug fixes, 28 other changes.

> **Important change**: this release has no breaking change that needs a migration and renames no persisted identifier, wire-protocol field, or profile format, so a v0.3.23 profile upgrades in place through the plugin manager's and Doctor's ordinary automatic upgrade paths with no manual configuration edit. What is worth knowing before upgrading: the LiangShen preset is reworked around programmatic tool presentation, collapsing the wire to the single `run_code` transport by default (`native` / `both` remain selectable), paging high-fan-out tool families until its own `tool_activate` loads a namespace, and adding a plugin settings card plus an opt-in phase-based reasoning budget; preset files still sync to `~/.dsh/.agent-presets` on startup, so a user who already selected the preset needs no manual step. The usage plugin drops its desktop-pet bubble announcements in favor of controls on the sidebar entry row with a collapsed usage strip, and folds dormant catalog aliases into their live route so one account no longer renders two balance rows. The task board remembers the parse model, adds create-and-run, and fixes the Windows case where a protected process reusing a PID made a stale ledger lock impossible to reclaim. The Skin Center adds four skins: Whale Girl / Sea Gaze (whale-maid), Anime Pixel (pixel-anime), island-life, and remiel-starlit. The community index registers seven PerryLink plugins together with `dsh-ppt-studio` and `dsh-workbench`. The Workshop gains an editor-picks category. CI adds the test-discipline gate and a coverage ratchet, and desktop packaging builds macOS architectures sequentially to prevent lock contention.

本次发布包含 1 项修复、2 项其他改动。

> **重要变更**：修复 v0.3.15 引入的聚合包回归——子插件挂载门控误读了启动载荷的线协议（启动条目只携带客户端 bundle 的包 id，不含补丁行 id 与启用状态），导致聚合安装后整个 dsh-web 插件家族的设置界面（Web 插件、皮肤中心、工坊、宠物、任务板、用量、会话归档等）全部消失。本版本恢复 v0.3.14 的挂载语义；[#1372](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1372)（隐藏已禁用家族行的 UI 入口）随之回退并保持开放，待宿主提供真实的行状态信号后再实现。

### 修复

- [web-all] 聚合包家族子插件按真实启动线协议挂载

### 其他改动

- [notes] 为 #1372 提出家族行状态路由方案
- [notes] 记录 v0.3.15 发布过程

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release contains 1 bug fix and 2 other changes.

> **Important change**: fixes the aggregate-package regression introduced in v0.3.15 — the child-mount gate misread the boot payload wire shape (boot entries only carry client-bundle package ids, never patch row ids or enable state), which hid the entire dsh-web plugin family settings UI (Web plugins, Skin Center, Workshop, Pet, Task Board, Usage, Session Archive, and more) after an aggregate install. This release restores the v0.3.14 mounting semantics; [#1372](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1372) (hide UI entry points of disabled family rows) is thereby reverted and stays open until the host provides a real row-state signal.

### Bug Fixes

- [web-all] mount aggregate family children against the real boot wire shape

### Other Changes

- [notes] propose the family row-state route for #1372

body.body:
本次发布包含 8 项新功能、8 项修复、6 项其他改动。

### 新功能

- [better-session] 内置 dsh-chat-recovery 替换为外部 @morlay/better-session：默认不激活，经 dsh-perf 设置卡内新增的会话管理卡片 opt-in 启用，启用时对旧数据做自动迁移
- [web-ui-all] 外部插件 bundle 扩容并恢复 better-session 0.0.11；未激活的外部扩展不再下发 harness patch
- [web-ui-all] 聚合 patches 新增顶层 section 能力，据此预置 web-ui-ssh bundle 行（默认停用）
- [ssh] 支持 keyboard-interactive 认证与交互式双因素提示（[#806](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/806)）
- [describe-image] 多端点轮换与故障转移
- [dsh-perf] 按插件活动归因的记分板与长任务来源日志
- [community-plugins] 社区插件索引登记 dsh-delete-message（[#1185](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1185)），并把 dsh-logicprobe 更新到 0.5.x
- [scripts] 新增 scripts/dsh-better-session.mjs opt-in 与迁移工具，应用前先执行导入检查并备份

### 修复

- [doctor] 修复 Windows CLI 入口检测与 schtasks 引号处理
- [task-board,pet] 修复返回按钮响应与重挂载韧性，支持段位 i18n 与语音覆盖（[#1233](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1233)、[#1226](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1226)）
- [skins] 释放根宽度锁，恢复侧栏列推移（[#1222](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1222)）
- [market-worker] worker 渲染的 HTML/markdown 增加 nosniff；CORS 预检以静态 allow-headers 应答
- [market-worker] 遥测读 key 只接受 header 提供；写请求体设上限并按 manifest 白名单校验资产 id；TURNSTILE_SECRET 未配置时写入一律 fail-closed

### 其他改动

- [repo] profile 重接线后退役 dsh-web-ui 兼容 symlink；本地 checkout 引用统一改为 dsh-web；忽略 .zcode 目录
- [perf] pet canvas frames2d 播放改用位图缓冲；task-board 重扫前先探测历史头部；skin-center 移除 orca-link 状态字符死写面；remote-web-ui 移动端 ChatView 将 live-event 折批量化
- [refactor] task-board 的新建/编辑弹窗共享外壳与内容字段；market/shell 把五处克隆收敛为单一 shim emitter core；vitest.setup.ts 同步到消费方并由 web-settings 再导出共享 vitest 配置；配对信任围栏整合进 shared/host/pair-access.ts

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release contains 8 new features, 8 bug fixes, and 6 other changes.

### New Features

- [better-session] The bundled dsh-chat-recovery is replaced by the external @morlay/better-session: inactive by default, enabled through an opt-in session-manager card inside the dsh-perf settings card, with automatic legacy-data migration on enable
- [web-ui-all] Expand the external-plugin bundles, restore better-session 0.0.11, and stop shipping harness patches for inactive external expansions
- [web-ui-all] The aggregate patch format gains a top-level section capability, used to seed a web-ui-ssh bundle row (disabled by default)
- [ssh] Support keyboard-interactive authentication and interactive two-factor prompts ([#806](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/806))
- [describe-image] Multi-endpoint rotation and failover
- [dsh-perf] Per-plugin activity attribution scoreboard and long-task source log
- [community-plugins] Register dsh-delete-message in the community plugin index ([#1185](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1185)) and update dsh-logicprobe to 0.5.x
- [scripts] Add the scripts/dsh-better-session.mjs opt-in and migration tooling, which runs the import check and takes a backup before applying

### Bug Fixes

- [doctor] Resolve the Windows CLI entry check and schtasks quoting
- [task-board,pet] Fix return-button response and remount resilience; support rank i18n and voice overrides ([#1233](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1233), [#1226](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1226))
- [skins] Release the root width lock to restore sidebar column push ([#1222](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1222))
- [market-worker] Send nosniff on worker-rendered HTML and markdown; answer CORS preflights with static allow-headers
- [market-worker] Accept the telemetry read key via header only; cap write bodies and allowlist asset ids against manifests; fail closed on writes when TURNSTILE_SECRET is unset
- [shared] Fix the structural ctx type in pair-access so the shared package typechecks standalone
- [dsh-perf] Reserve assistant shadow priority headroom against message-actions
- [ssh] Complete the mock TerminalConnection in terminal tests

### Other Changes

- [repo] Retire the dsh-web-ui compat symlink after profile rewiring; relocate local checkout references to dsh-web; ignore the local .zcode directory
- [perf] Canvas bitmap buffering for pet frames2d playback; probe history head before re-scanning wedged executions in task-board; drop orca-link status-character dead-write surfaces in skin-center; batch live-event folding in the remote-web-ui mobile ChatView
- [refactor] Share the modal shell and content fields between task-board create/edit modals; extract one shim emitter core from five clones in market/shell; sync vitest.setup.ts to consumers and re-export the shared vitest config from web-settings; consolidate the pairing trust fence into shared/host/pair-access.ts
- [artifacts] Refresh the reviewed-skin hash table, the reviewed-hooks registry, and stale market/dist
- [readme] Add a DSH compatibility badge to the root README pair
- [docs] Batch of decision records (catppuccin mixed-artifact rejection, delete-message merge plus four registration review rounds, logicprobe and milestone maintenance rounds, evidence-gated plugin presentation dormancy proposal, Turnstile iframe origin policy options, large-unit split backlog proposal, phase-1 performance verification snapshot archive)

Compatibility: this release passed the automatic-upgrade compatibility audit (package identity, profile writes, persisted identifiers, wire protocol, and cross-platform lifecycle compared between v0.3.5 and v0.3.6); no blocking changes were found. Every surviving package keeps its npm name, exports shape (one additive dsh-perf export), engines floor, bundle row ids, and settings ids unchanged; shared/host/legacy-migration.ts is untouched and the legacy aggregate name stays deprecated with no republication. Persisted identifiers are frozen: the only removed identifiers belong to the deleted dsh-chat-recovery package itself (its web-ui-chat-recovery mount row goes with it); every added identifier is opt-in or seeded disabled — the three @morlay/better-session insert rows ship behind trailing disabled:true overrides, web-ui-ssh is seeded with config enabled:false once the user edits it settings wins — and the only new persisted key is the additive dsh-perf-debug debug flag.

Upgrading changes nothing by design: better-session stays inactive after an automatic update, so neither the plugin-manager update path nor the Doctor pre-launch path runs any data migration, both behave identically, and a bare "dsh web" is equally unaffected while the stock jsonl session backend keeps serving all existing sessions. The chat-recovery to better-session move is an explicit user action: scripts/dsh-better-session.mjs offers status/migrate/enable/disable, where migrate defaults to dry-run, refuses stores whose application_id/user_version fingerprint does not match @morlay/session-rdb@0.0.11, takes an automatic backup before its first write, and converges on reruns via INSERT OR IGNORE anchors. If migration fails, keep that backup, leave better-session disabled, and rerun after repairing; sessions were never removed from disk at any point in this flow.

This release validates the full local gate suite (sync-shared, typecheck, workspace tests, script tests, aggregate, runtime-deps, market, skin-center, docs), verify-version against all 19 family packages, and the fresh aggregate mount composition (19 rows / 17 deps). It does not claim a real previous-version-to-target upgrade drill or a full macOS / Windows upgrade matrix; the Windows doctor fixes (#1238) carry their own CLI-entry and service-planning regression tests. For manual recovery of a broken profile, back up package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and cordis.patch.yml in the profile directory, then run:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@0.3.6
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

If migration fails, keep the backups and do not start a bare dsh web; repair the profile and run --dump-config again.

</details>

- [community] 社区插件索引登记 dsh-mcp-manager 与 dsh-provider-usage

### 修复

- [task-board] 会话列表抖动时不再隐式关闭看板
- [task-board] 修复看板导航抖动、皮肤遮罩冲突，并补桌面 profile 文档

- [dsh-perf] 修复客户端 bundle 导出与 locales 语法
- [readme] dshfind 下载徽章改用 HTML 渲染

### 其他改动

- [dsh-web-all] 聚合包新增内置 dsh-perf（bundle 行 + 官方写批延迟 200→500ms，其余键与官方默认一致）
- [market] 退役旧版皮肤画廊站点、模拟器管线与 301 重定向

- [skin] 回滚「修复特殊皮肤的异常载入问题」（该修复未纳入本版）
- [docs] dsh-perf 优化报告与设计理由落库

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release contains 13 new features, 12 bug fixes, and 12 other changes.

### New Features

- [dsh-perf] The performance engine ships for the first time as a built-in plugin: DSH Web performance observation and governance (HUD, alerting, write-batch throttling, render offloading, subagent storm alerts, idle observation, and settings cards)
- [dsh-perf] Session-list publish gating (projection flushes merged to 1Hz) plus a stream-forward cooldown experiment (off by default)
- [dsh-perf] Sidebar session-row content-visibility offloading (large better-sidebar group expansion)
- [git-graph] Git worktree parallel sessions (blank-session branch selector plus Git graph)
- [task-board] Drag and drop to move cards between manual columns
- [skin-center] User skin uninstall and integrity verification with auto-repair
- [market] Workshop install counts and per-plugin npm downloads
- [market] Two-level plugin subcategory filtering
- [market] Drop the decorative artwork placeholder on plugin cards
- [telemetry] Paginated dark dashboard for tv.dsh-market.com
- [pet] Murmurs follow session context and the current session
- [remote-web-ui] Manual pairing token input on the fence screen
- [community] Register dsh-mcp-manager and dsh-provider-usage in the community plugin index

### Bug Fixes

- [task-board] Never close the board implicitly on session-list churn
- [task-board] Resolve navigation jitter, skin scrim clobber, and document the desktop profile
- [skin-center] Restore legacy market skin hooks
- [skin-center] Reduce orca-link session-switch latency
- [orca-link] Fix the orca-link chain problem (mount binding scope)
- [market] Hydrate injected npm downloads in remote card mode
- [web-settings] Add market and skin namespaces to the bridge allowlist
- [tool-describe-image] Invalidate the client capability cache on native images toggle
- [telemetry-view] Serve the dashboard client as same-origin /app.js, opt out of Rocket Loader, and surface client errors
- [dsh-perf] Render offloading fix (keep the look shadow + P0 CSS) and M1-M4 audit fixes
- [dsh-perf] Fix the client bundle export and locales syntax
- [readme] Render the dshfind download badge as HTML

### Other Changes

- [dsh-web-all] Bundle dsh-perf as a built-in (bundle row plus harness write-behind delay 200→500ms; remaining keys match the official defaults)
- [market] Retire the legacy gallery site, simulator pipeline, and 301 redirect
- [skills] Rename developer skills with the dsh-web- prefix (dsh-web-community-plugin-developer and others)
- [docs] Sweep Web UI Plugins wording to Web Plugins after the dsh-web rename
- [readme] Badge, sponsorship QR, community QR, and tagline adjustments
- [readme] Sync the contributor list from the GitHub API
- [community] Community plugin index maintenance round
- [pet] Drop orphaned keyword-rule voice-pack caps
- [process] Decision records (deepsea review, skill rename, and others)
- [notes] Batch-record decision notes inside this release
- [skin] Revert the "fix special skin abnormal loading" change (that fix is not part of this release)
- [docs] Land the dsh-perf optimization report and design rationale

Compatibility: this release passed the automatic-upgrade compatibility audit (package identity, profile writes, persisted identifiers, wire protocol, and cross-platform lifecycle compared between v0.3.4 and v0.3.5); no blocking changes were found. Every existing package keeps its npm name, exports, bundle patch, and settings ids byte-for-byte. Persisted identifiers are frozen: no existing localStorage key, settings section id, API path, or profile/bundle row was removed or renamed — all new keys (dsh-perf-css, dsh-perf-stream-cooldown, dsh-perf-debug) belong to the new built-in plugin, and all new API endpoints (/api/skin-center/v2/verify, /skins/:id/uninstall, /skins/:id/repair) are additive. The skin manifest v2 schema is unchanged. dsh-perf now mounts inside the aggregate: its patch replaces the official session-persistence-jsonl row config as a whole (writeBatchMaxDelayMs 200→500ms) while restating every key the base row owns, verified against the official schema defaults; the plugin row itself is enabled with the same defaults as a standalone install (meter 2000ms, window 120s).

The legacy aggregate @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all dual-publish window ended with this release: v0.3.5 is the final dual-published version (v0.3.3/v0.3.4/v0.3.5 carry dsh.migrate metadata); the legacy name is now deprecated with a migration notice and future releases stop publishing it. Automatic migration of legacy profiles uses the deterministic map in shared/host/legacy-migration.ts, consistent between plugin-manager and Doctor.

Doctor auto-migration keeps its previous behavior: enabled by default for dsh-doctor launch, the Doctor service launcher, and "dsh-doctor migrate"; a bare "dsh web" does not pass through the Doctor preflight.

This release validates the full local gate suite (sync-shared, typecheck, 21-workspace tests, script tests, aggregate, runtime-deps, market, skin-center), the fresh aggregate mount composition (20 rows / 18 deps), and verify-version against all 20 family packages. It does not claim a real previous-version-to-target upgrade drill or a real macOS / Windows upgrade matrix. For manual recovery of a legacy profile, back up package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml in the profile directory, then run:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@0.3.5
dsh plugin --profile web remove @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

If migration fails, keep the backup and do not start a bare dsh web; repair the profile and run --dump-config again.

</details>

---

body.name: dsh-web v0.3.4
body.body:
本次发布包含 16 项新功能、18 项修复、18 项其他改动。

### 新功能

- [dsh-pet] 以代币经济统一 miku 玩法
- [skin-center] WE 皮肤 v0.2.0 针对壁纸专属场景的优化
- [dsh-pet] frames2d 渲染器与玩法契约，miku 作为 Workshop 宠物
- [dsh-pet] 以 frames2d 玩法宠物形态发布 miku
- [dsh-pet] 新增客户端玩法 HUD 与循环
- [dsh-pet] 新增玩法契约、宿主引擎与动词路由
- [dsh-pet] 新增 frames2d 客户端渲染器，含相位映射与拖拽轨迹
- [dsh-pet] 在宿主注册表中解析 frames2d 宠物
- [skins] 完成 orca-link v2 移植，含完整钩子、预览与 Workshop 资产
- [dsh-pet] 为 v2 清单契约新增 frames2d 渲染器种类
- [skins] 新增 orca-link v2 资产皮肤（移植自 Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale）
- [pet] 新增 OUO Neko v2 伴侣 ([#1118](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1118))
- [skins] 新增 Skyrail Cabin 皮肤 ([#1087](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1087))
- [market] 将设置段入口 id 隔离到 dsh-workshop，避免与其他插件市场的槽位冲突
- [community] 将 dsh-context 调整至第四位
- [web] 简化 Workshop 与编辑挂起任务

### 修复

- [dsh-pet] 玩法卡片改在宠物旁边打开
- [dsh-pet] 玩法入口移入悬停面板
- [desktop-launcher] 将快捷方式 WorkingDirectory 隔离到 scriptsDir ([#1159](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1159))
- [runtime] 解决 Workshop 安装、壁纸降级、原生图片、重试与 ptc 问题 (#1141 #1145 #1154 #1155 #1153 #1149)
- [issues] 将所有 issue 路由给协作者
- [settings-card] 卡片头部不再超出卡片边界
- [dsh-pet] 玩法卡片从宠物停靠处向上展开
- [skin-center] 将 token 审计的 at-rule 递归限定在自身块内
- [doctor] 客户端 API 前缀默认改为 /api/doctor
- [skill-explorer, pet] 技能列表支持活动会话工作目录 ([#1139](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1139))，并移除侵入式宠物关闭按钮 ([#1126](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1126))

- 解决 Windows 与 macOS 的路径分隔符与权限差异
- [remote-web-ui] 移动端斜杠命令改经宿主命令注册表路由 ([#1125](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1125))
- [skin-center] 确保暗色模式推荐徽章对比度 ([#1117](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1117))
- [skins] 恢复 maid-atelier 系统对话框层级 ([#1116](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1116))
- [market] 以符合规范的头部偏移重写 zipStore ([#1050](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1050))

### 其他改动

- [readme] 从 GitHub API 同步贡献者列表

- [notes] 记录 PR #1118 完成并在维护运行中合入
- [notes] 记录 2026-08-25 维护运行（skyrail cabin 合入、社区插件证据门禁）
- [readme] 移除月度下载徽章
- [readme] SEO 优化，补充救援模式与 liangshen 章节
- [ui] 优化移动端 bundle 压缩、技能中心样式与皮肤背景遮挡 (#1066, #1112, #1000)
- [market] 重建皮肤 zip 归档与 dist 清单 ([#1050](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1050))
- [issues] 默认 issue 路由到 Aa728848

兼容性说明：本版本通过自动升级兼容性审计（对比 v0.3.3 与 v0.3.4 的包身份、profile 写入、持久化标识、线协议与跨平台生命周期），未发现需要阻断的变更。dsh-market 的设置段入口 id 由 dsh-web-ui-market 改为 dsh-workshop（设置命名空间与已保存配置不变，没有任何按段入口 id 持久化的状态），库存档配置不受影响。dsh-pet 的 $DSH_HOME/pet.json 新增可选 gameplay 字段（旧文档加载为空映射；旧货币在结算时确定性并入点心账本，不删除已有数据）。其余持久化标识（dsh-web-ui-telemetry-*、dsh-market-web-fp、皮肤背景命名空间、skin-center-active.json、task-board ledger、doctor 状态目录）均保持冻结；API 路径仅新增、无移除或改名。

Doctor 自动迁移默认开启，覆盖 dsh-doctor launch、Doctor 服务启动与 dsh-doctor migrate；裸 dsh web 不经过 Doctor preflight。

本版本是旧聚合包 @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all 双发布过渡窗口的第二个也是最后一个版本：v0.3.4 仍会发布带 dsh.migrate 元数据的旧包对应版本，此后的版本不再发布旧包，并改为执行 npm deprecate。旧 profile 的自动迁移使用 shared/host/legacy-migration.ts 的确定性映射，plugin-manager 与 Doctor 行为一致。

本版本验证了全新安装、迁移单元测试与 Linux CI 挂载 smoke；未宣称上一版本到目标版本的真实升级演练，也未宣称 macOS / Windows 的真实升级矩阵。旧 profile 需要手动恢复时，请先备份 profile 目录中的 package.json 与 pnpm-lock.yaml，再按以下顺序执行：

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@0.3.4
dsh plugin --profile web remove @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

若迁移失败，保留备份并不要启动裸 dsh web；修复 profile 后再次执行 --dump-config。

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

This release contains 16 new features, 18 bug fixes, 18 other changes.

### New Features

- [dsh-pet] unify miku gameplay on the treats economy
- [skin-center] WE skin v0.2.0 optimizations for wallpaper-exclusive scenarios
- [dsh-pet] frames2d renderer and gameplay contract, miku as a Workshop pet
- [dsh-pet] ship miku as a frames2d gameplay pet
- [dsh-pet] add the client gameplay HUD and loops
- [dsh-pet] add the gameplay contract, host engine and verb routes
- [dsh-pet] add the frames2d client renderer with phase mapping and drag track
- [dsh-pet] resolve frames2d pets in the host registry
- [skins] complete orca-link v2 port with full hooks, previews and workshop assets
- [dsh-pet] add frames2d renderer kind to the v2 manifest contract
- [skins] add orca-link v2 asset skin (port of Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale)
- [pet] add OUO Neko v2 companion ([#1118](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1118))
- [skins] add Skyrail Cabin skin ([#1087](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1087))
- [market] isolate settings section id to dsh-workshop to prevent slot collisions with plugin markets
- [community] add dsh-context at fourth position
- [web] simplify workshop and edit pending tasks

### Bug Fixes

- [dsh-pet] open the gameplay card beside the pet
- [dsh-pet] move the gameplay entry into the hover panel
- [desktop-launcher] isolate shortcut WorkingDirectory to scriptsDir ([#1159](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1159))
- [runtime] resolve workshop install, wallpaper degradation, native images, retry and ptc issues (#1141 #1145 #1154 #1155 #1153 #1149)
- [issues] route all issues to collaborator
- [settings-card] keep the card header inside the card bounds
- [dsh-pet] grow the gameplay card upward from the pet dock
- [skin-center] bound token-audit at-rule recursion to its own block
- [doctor] default client API base to /api/doctor
- [skill-explorer, pet] support active session cwd in skill list ([#1139](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1139)) and remove intrusive pet close button ([#1126](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1126))
- [liangshen] broadcast tools/presentation-changed on PTC Mode switch ([#1128](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1128))
- [skin-center] use line scroll-margin instead of scrollport scroll-padding to avoid caret drift ([#1133](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1133))
- resolve cross-platform path separator and permission differences for Windows and macOS
- [remote-web-ui] route mobile slash commands through host command registry ([#1125](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1125))
- [skin-center] ensure dark-mode tag contrast for recommended badge ([#1117](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1117))
- [skins] restore system dialog z-index in maid-atelier ([#1116](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1116))
- [market] rewrite zipStore with spec-compliant header offsets ([#1050](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1050))
- [skin-center] guard scope replay from overwriting v2 background state (#1109, #1107)

### Other Changes

- [readme] sync contributor list from GitHub API
- [process] mark issue fallback decision superseded
- [dsh-market] refresh client bundle with the settings-card box-sizing fix
- [readme] register third-party sources as a folded list and fill the license gaps
- [notes] record the frames2d + gameplay contract and miku migration
- [dsh-web] the dsh-miku-pet plugin package was re-added and removed again inside the window (never published; miku ships as a dsh-pet frames2d gameplay pet)
- [notes] record workshop deployment round for orca-link store listing
- [skin-center] rebuild lib after token-audit bound fix
- [market] deploy the Workshop on dev pushes, decoupled from releases
- [notes] record PR #1118 completion and merge in maintenance run
- [notes] record 2026-08-25 maintenance run (skyrail cabin merge, community plugin evidence gate)
- [readme] remove monthly downloads badge
- [readme] seo pass with rescue mode and liangshen sections
- [ui] optimize mobile bundle compression, skill center styling, and skin background occlusion (#1066, #1112, #1000)
- [market] regenerate skin zip archives and dist manifests ([#1050](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues/1050))
- [issues] route default issues to Aa728848

Compatibility: this release passed the automatic-upgrade compatibility audit (package identity, profile writes, persisted identifiers, wire protocol, and cross-platform lifecycle compared between v0.3.3 and v0.3.4); no blocking changes were found. The dsh-market settings section entry id changed from dsh-web-ui-market to dsh-workshop (the settings namespace and saved config are unchanged, and no state is persisted keyed by the section entry id), so existing saved configuration is unaffected. dsh-pet's $DSH_HOME/pet.json gains an optional gameplay field (old documents load as an empty map; legacy currencies are deterministically merged into the treat ledger on settle, existing data is never deleted). All other persisted identifiers (dsh-web-ui-telemetry-*, dsh-market-web-fp, skin background namespaces, skin-center-active.json, task-board ledger, doctor state directory) stay frozen; API paths are additive only, none removed or renamed.

Doctor auto-migration is enabled by default for dsh-doctor launch, the Doctor service launcher, and dsh-doctor migrate. A bare dsh web does not pass through the Doctor preflight.

This is the second and final version of the legacy aggregate dual-publish window: v0.3.4 still publishes the matching @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all with dsh.migrate metadata, and later versions stop publishing the legacy package and run npm deprecate instead. Automatic migration of legacy profiles uses the deterministic map in shared/host/legacy-migration.ts, consistent between plugin-manager and Doctor.

This release validates fresh installation, migration unit tests, and the Linux CI mount smoke. It does not claim a real previous-version-to-target upgrade drill or a real macOS / Windows upgrade matrix. For manual recovery of a legacy profile, back up package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml in the profile directory, then run:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@0.3.4
dsh plugin --profile web remove @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

If migration fails, keep the backup and do not start a bare dsh web; repair the profile and run --dump-config again.

</details>

---

body.name: dsh-web v0.3.3
body.body:
本次发布包含 3 项新功能、6 项修复、6 项其他改动。

### 新功能

- [dsh-web] 为旧聚合包提供 Doctor 与插件管理器的确定性自动迁移
- [market] 新增累计 npm 下载量与遥测用户公共徽章

### 修复

- [doctor] Windows Doctor 启动器和迁移通过受限 cmd.exe shim 安全调用 dsh.cmd

### 其他改动

body.name: dsh-web-ui v0.2.4
body.body:
This release contains 11 new features, 25 bug fixes, 22 other changes.
本次发布包含 11 项新功能、25 项修复、22 项其他改动。

### New Features / 新功能

- [describe-image] rc.8 native-image toggle for the DeepSeek adapter / [describe-image] DeepSeek 适配器新增 rc.8 native-image 开关
- [skin-center] live WebGL player for Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers / [skin-center] Wallpaper Engine 场景壁纸实时 WebGL 播放器
- [dsh-desktop-launcher] add desktop launcher + one-click shutdown plugin / [dsh-desktop-launcher] 新增桌面启动器与一键关机插件
- [pet] whale status ornament and decoration client render ([#567](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/567) [#463](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/463)) / [pet] 鲸鱼状态挂件与装饰客户端渲染
- [pet] status-decoration protocol, registry and asset route ([#567](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/567)) / [pet] 状态装饰协议、注册表与资产路由
- [pet] render panel chrome from the pet voice pack ([#677](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/677)) / [pet] 面板 chrome 改由宠物语音包渲染
- [pet] voice.json packs and panel chrome through registry and service ([#677](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/677)) / [pet] voice.json 语音包与面板 chrome 经注册表和服务加载
- [pet] voice-pack pool layer for status and whisper copy ([#677](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/677)) / [pet] 语音包池层承担状态与耳语文案
- [chat-recovery] edit last completed message and supervised turn retry ([#316](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/316)) / [chat-recovery] 支持编辑上一条已完成消息与受监督的回合重试
- [community-plugins] register dsh-session-delete in community index / [community-plugins] 社区索引登记 dsh-session-delete
- [community-plugins] register dsh-logicprobe in community index / [community-plugins] 社区索引登记 dsh-logicprobe

### Bug Fixes / 修复

- [describe-image] invalidate the cached capability verdict after a native-image toggle / [describe-image] native-image 切换后使缓存的能力判定失效
- [chat-recovery,skin-center] bind uSES store accessors for rc.8 slot rendering / [chat-recovery,skin-center] 为 rc.8 插槽渲染绑定 uSES store 访问器
- [shared] mirror rc.8 shell frozen module table in platform seed (#sdk-rc8) / [shared] 平台种子镜像 rc.8 shell 冻结模块表
- [skin-center] residual scene-player hardening ([#717](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/717)) / [skin-center] 场景播放器残余加固
- [skin-center] harden WE wallpaper routes and scene parsing ([#717](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/717)) / [skin-center] 加固 WE 壁纸路由与场景解析
- [pet] wire global panel, stabilize ornament loop and harden decoration/voice-pack inputs ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) ([#706](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/706)) / [pet] 接通全局面板，稳定挂件循环，加固装饰与语音包输入
- [skill-explorer] use bg-overlay for the floating modal card ([#659](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/659)) / [skill-explorer] 浮动模态卡改用 bg-overlay
- [skins] strip every legacy managed section and empty insert rows ([#676](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/676)) / [skins] 剔除全部遗留托管段与空插入行
- [plugin-manager] resolve the dsh bin script under the npx layout ([#683](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/683)) / [plugin-manager] npx 布局下解析 dsh 可执行脚本
- [skins] drive whale-mom bg-base alpha purely by the scrim slider ([#635](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/635)) / [skins] whale-mom bg-base 透明度仅由遮罩滑块控制
- [skin-center] write the active skin selection atomically ([#678](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/678)) / [skin-center] 活动皮肤选择原子写入
- [remote-web-ui] detect linked aggregate children / [remote-web-ui] 识别软链接的聚合子包
- [community-plugins] prevent stale connections from overriding plugin state / [community-plugins] 避免旧连接覆盖插件状态
- [skin-center] tolerate CRLF line endings when reading the legacy active skin / [skin-center] 读取遗留活动皮肤时容忍 CRLF 行尾
- [skins] keep legacy junction targets resolvable ([#605](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/605)) / [skins] 保持遗留 junction 目标可解析
- [plugin-manager] serialize profile mutations / [plugin-manager] 串行化 profile 变更
- [shared] keep an in-flight edit to the same field being saved / [shared] 保持对同一字段进行中的编辑被保存
- [ssh] make connection probe work on Windows targets / [ssh] 连接探测支持 Windows 目标
- [skin-center] auto sync wallpaper on boot and initialize active skin synchronously / [skin-center] 启动时自动同步壁纸并同步初始化活动皮肤
- [skin-center] import catalog with file URL ([#633](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/633)) / [skin-center] 支持以 file URL 导入目录
- [dsh-skill-explorer] refuse deletion of linked (symlinked) skills ([#606](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/606)) / [dsh-skill-explorer] 拒绝删除软链接的技能
- [dsh-skill-explorer] follow symlinked skill dirs and .md files when scanning ([#606](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/606)) / [dsh-skill-explorer] 扫描时跟随软链接技能目录与 .md 文件
- [ssh] refit terminal on container resize so the last line stays visible / [ssh] 容器尺寸变化时重排终端，保持最后一行可见
- [git-graph] clamp the graph limit and stop resetting the dialog on re-render / [git-graph] 限制图上限，重渲染不再重置对话框
- [task-board] re-arm reconcile when a session change arrives mid-pass / [task-board] 会话变化在扫描中途到达时重新武装对账

### Other Changes / 其他改动

- [archive] finalize rc.8 upgrade validation snapshot / [archive] 定稿 rc.8 升级验证快照
- [web-ui-all] pin dsh-better-sidebar to 0.14.0 (rc.8 cohort) / [web-ui-all] 锁定 dsh-better-sidebar 0.14.0（rc.8 配套版本）
- [skin-center] regenerate client bundle with bound store accessors / [skin-center] 重建客户端 bundle 并绑定 store 访问器
- [archive] record rc.8 upgrade validation snapshot / [archive] 记录 rc.8 升级验证快照
- [sdk] pin rc.8 platform seed and inject-module contracts / [sdk] 锁定 rc.8 平台种子与 inject-module 契约
- [describe-image] fill rc.8 maxImageDimension limit in store fixtures / [describe-image] store 夹具补齐 rc.8 maxImageDimension 上限
- [sdk] upgrade official SDK cohort to rc.8 / [sdk] 官方 SDK 配套升级至 rc.8
- [pr-evidence] drop mis-uploaded we-scene screenshots ([#717](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/717)) / [pr-evidence] 删除误传的 we-scene 截图
- [pr-evidence] WE scene wallpaper live-render evidence screenshots / [pr-evidence] WE 场景壁纸实时渲染证据截图
- [skin-center] regenerate bundle with merged legacy fixes (#672 #676 #678) / [skin-center] 合并遗留修复后重建 bundle
- [dsh-skins] align retired skin shim versions to 0.2.3 / [dsh-skins] 退役皮肤 shim 版本对齐 0.2.3
- [archive] record issue 689 desktop-launcher acceptance ([#689](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/689)) / [archive] 记录 issue 689 桌面启动器验收
- [desktop-launcher] record aggregate workspace dep in lockfile / [desktop-launcher] lockfile 记录聚合 workspace 依赖
- [desktop-launcher] drop stray issue snapshot file from package / [desktop-launcher] 从包中移除遗留 issue 快照文件
- [scripts] cover desktop-launcher in sync-shared copy counts / [scripts] sync-shared 拷贝计数覆盖 desktop-launcher
- [desktop-launcher] register new plugin in aggregate, allowlist and sync-shared manifests / [desktop-launcher] 在聚合、白名单与 sync-shared 清单登记新插件
- [archive] PR/Issue 维护摘要 2026-08-19 / [archive] PR/Issue 维护摘要 2026-08-19
- [readme] sync contributor list from GitHub API / [readme] 从 GitHub API 同步贡献者名单
- [pet] reduce high-resolution Live2D texture overhead / [pet] 降低高分辨率 Live2D 纹理开销
- [archive] handoff note for issue 316 merge pending human review ([#316](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/316)) / [archive] issue 316 合并待人工审查的交接记录
- [dsh-skill-explorer] add live GUI evidence for linked-skill recognition ([#606](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/606)) / [dsh-skill-explorer] 补充链接技能识别的实机 GUI 证据
- [community-plugins] restore trailing newlines in generated index / [community-plugins] 恢复生成索引的末尾换行

body.name: dsh-web-ui v0.2.3
body.body:
This release contains 13 new features, 4 bug fixes, 4 other changes.
本次发布包含 13 项新功能、4 项修复、4 项其他改动。

### New Features / 新功能

- [pet] pet center milestone M2: manifest v2 schema with a fail-closed parser and v1 compat read ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 宠物中心 M2：清单 v2 schema 与 fail-closed 解析器，v1 兼容读取
- [pet] wire the registry onto manifest-v2 and add the $DSH_HOME/pets source with structured diagnostics ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 注册表接入清单 v2，新增 $DSH_HOME/pets 来源与结构化诊断
- [pet] add the renderer contract, registry and change-only phase stream ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 新增渲染器契约、注册表与变更才派发的相位流
- [pet] add the v1 to v2 manifest migration codemod and the validate/install CLI with the model3 closure extractor ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 新增 v1→v2 清单迁移 codemod，以及带 model3 闭包提取器的 validate/install CLI
- [pet] add the client renderer switch, surface registry diagnostics in the pet settings card, and document the pet center ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 新增客户端渲染器分发缝，设置页宠物栏目呈现注册表诊断并补齐文档
- [pet] pet center milestone M3: Live2D renderer — phase-to-motion mapping with idle fallback, hit-area tap feedback, localized diagnostic cards ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 宠物中心 M3：Live2D 渲染器——相位到动作组映射（idle 兜底）、命中区点击反馈、双语诊断卡
- [pet] build the Live2D vendor stack (pixi.js + engine, both MIT) as a lazy-loaded IIFE; sprite-only installs never pay for it ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / Live2D vendor 栈（pixi.js + 引擎，均 MIT）构建为按需加载的 IIFE，纯 sprite 用户零成本
- [pet] list live2d pets with their model closure servable set and serve the closure plus plugin runtime files over the asset/runtime routes ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / live2d 宠物携带模型闭包白名单上市，资产/运行时路由放行闭包与插件运行时文件
- [pet] Cubism Core stays user-supplied (never bundled or downloaded); install guidance ships in the README and the in-GUI diagnostic card ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / Cubism Core 保持用户自备（不内置不代下），安装指引见 README 与 GUI 诊断卡

### Bug Fixes / 修复

- [skin-center] restore the persisted wallpaper at boot / 启动时恢复持久化的壁纸
- [pet] fence pet asset routes with realpath containment and size caps ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 宠物资产路由加 realpath 包含检查与容量上限
- [pet] keep manifest-v2 erasable for strip-only consumers ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 保持 manifest-v2 可擦除语法以兼容 strip-only 消费者
- [pet] reject dot segments in manifest asset paths ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 清单资产路径拒绝点段

### Other Changes / 其他改动

- [ssh] declare @deepseek-ai/dsh-scope and dsh-timeout explicitly so tests resolve under a fresh frozen install / 显式声明 @deepseek-ai/dsh-scope 与 dsh-timeout，保证全新 frozen 安装下测试可解析
- [pet] migrate the built-in pets to manifest v2 and lock the schema file to the validator ([#623](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/623)) / 内置宠物迁移到清单 v2，schema 文件与校验器漂移互锁
- [e2e-mount] targeted rewrite for unpublished family deps, post-publish strict mount gate / 未发布家族依赖的定向改写与发布后严格挂载门禁
- [readme] sync contributor list from GitHub API / 从 GitHub API 同步贡献者名单

---

Maintained bilingual release notes (docs/release-notes/v0.2.3.md). / 维护者逐条双语发布说明（docs/release-notes/v0.2.3.md）。

body.name: dsh-web-ui v0.2.2
body.body:
This release contains 12 new features, 21 bug fixes, 14 other changes.
本次发布包含 12 项新功能、21 项修复、14 项其他改动。

- [plugin-manager] strip duplicate-mount bundles entries after CLI mutations / CLI 变更后清理重复挂载的 bundle 条目

- [community-plugins] register dsh-notifier in the community index (event notifications) / 在社区索引登记 dsh-notifier（事件通知）

- [plugin-manager] conflict repair handoff, duplicate-id auto-disable, and boot preflight / 冲突修复交接、重复 id 自动禁用与启动预检
- [plugin-manager] add CLI gateway so the tab works on the npm web runtime / 新增 CLI 网关，让插件管理页在 npm web 运行时可用
- [plugin-manager] add family plugin manager tab over the official installer channels / 在官方安装通道之上新增插件管理页
- [describe-image] add model fetch and connectivity probe to settings card / 设置卡新增模型获取与连通性探测

### Bug Fixes / 修复

- [community-plugins] drop stale npm field from Chat Summary entry / 移除 Chat Summary 条目中过期的 npm 字段
- [community-plugins] fold pnpm github/gitlab/bitbucket shorthands in git matching / git 匹配中并入 pnpm 的 github/gitlab/bitbucket 简写
- [skins] soften whale-mom bubble opacity behind one alpha variable ([#486](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/486)) / 用单个 alpha 变量柔化 whale-mom 气泡透明度

- [web-ui-all] restore pruned lockfile entries with minimal importer additions / 以最小 importer 增量恢复被修剪的锁文件条目
- [remote-web-ui] confirm before running the sidebar update ([#507](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/507)) / 执行侧边栏更新前先确认
- [skin-center] resolve real scene containers and decode loose scene projects ([#521](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/521)) / 解析真实场景容器并解码松散场景工程
- [ssh] guard HostsTab load setState against post-unmount settle / 防护 HostsTab 加载 setState 在卸载后结算

body.name: dsh-web-ui v0.2.1
body.body:
This release contains 40 new features, 31 bug fixes, 46 other changes.
本次发布包含 40 项新功能、31 项修复、46 项其他改动。

### New Features / 新功能

- [release] generate bilingual release notes (EN + ZH) / 生成中英双语发布说明（EN + ZH）
- [skins] add Summer Liquid Glass (夏沫琉璃) skin (v2) / 新增「夏沫琉璃」皮肤（v2）
- [skins,miku] port custom cursors, light art and collapse handling to v2 / 将自定义光标、亮色插画与折叠处理迁移到 v2
- [skin-center] derive tinted fallbacks for uncovered official tokens ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 为未被覆盖的官方 token 推导着色回退值
- [skins,miku] port the Miku custom node cursors from the v1 theme into the v2 skin / 将 Miku 主题的自定义节点光标从 v1 迁移进 v2 皮肤
- [web-ui-settings] apply the optimized select to the side-card toggles / 将优化后的 select 应用到侧卡开关
- [web-ui-settings] refine custom select behavior / 打磨自定义 select 行为
- [community-plugins] add npm install source for dsh-memoir entry / 为 dsh-memoir 条目增加 npm install 来源
- [skin-center] link-based stylesheet install, live theme subscription, dragon-heir dark art ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 基于链接的样式表安装、主题实时订阅与 dragon-heir 暗色插画
- [gallery,scripts] point the gallery and scaffolding at the v2 skin asset directories ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 让画廊与脚手架指向 v2 皮肤资产目录
- [skin-center] complete the built-in skin hooks ports ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 完成内置皮肤 hooks 移植
- [scripts] rewrite dsh-skin as the v2 validate/install tool and gate user hooks ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 将 dsh-skin 重写为 v2 校验/安装工具并门禁用户 hooks
- [plugins] opt into the L2 semantic attributes ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 接入 L2 语义属性
- [skin-center] add mint, the official-anchored pure-token example skin ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 新增 mint（官方锚定的纯 token 范例皮肤）
- [settings] optimize the select component under default appearance / 优化默认外观下的 select 组件
- [skin-center] migrate the 11 built-in skins to v2 asset directories ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 将 11 个内置皮肤迁移到 v2 资产目录
- [scripts] add the v1 to v2 skin migration codemod ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 新增 v1 到 v2 皮肤迁移 codemod
- [skin-center] re-export the contract surface for tooling ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 为工具链重新导出契约面
- [skin-center] enforce the background priority chain (WE > manual > skin media) ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 强制背景优先级链（壁纸引擎 > 手动 > 皮肤媒体）
- [web-ui-settings] refine custom select behavior / 打磨自定义 select 行为
- [skin-center] wire the v2 runtime through the UI and host entry ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 将 v2 运行时接入 UI 与宿主入口
- [community-plugins] register dsh-full-remote in community index / 在社区索引登记 dsh-full-remote
- [community-plugins] register dsh-palate in community index / 在社区索引登记 dsh-palate
- [skin-center] add the try-on lifecycle to the skin controller ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 为皮肤控制器新增试穿生命周期
- [remote-web-ui] select agent preset for mobile sessions ([#397](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/397)) / 移动会话可选择 agent 预设
- [skin-center] add the v2 client runtime (layers, semantic adapter, controller) ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 新增 v2 客户端运行时（图层、语义适配器、控制器）
- [skin-center] add the v2 host side (skin repo, routes, tapIndex adapter) ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 新增 v2 宿主侧（皮肤仓库、路由、tapIndex 适配器）
- [skin-center] add the fail-closed skin CSS safety pipeline ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 新增默认关闭的皮肤 CSS 安全管线
- [skin-center] pin the skin manifest v2 contract surface ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 钉住皮肤清单 v2 契约面
- [pet] refresh whisper and remark pools with livelier lines / 以更生动的台词刷新耳语与备注词库
- [skill-explorer] allow paired devices on skill center routes / 允许配对设备访问技能中心路由
- [pet] unify whispers into the status bubble and collapse multi-session stacks / 将耳语统一进状态气泡并折叠多会话堆叠
- [describe-image] hide describe_image from multimodal sessions / 在多模态会话中隐藏 describe_image
- [community-plugins] register dsh-archive-manager and dsh-history-tree / 在社区索引登记 dsh-archive-manager 与 dsh-history-tree
- [community-plugins] register dsh-gzip in the community index (gzip-compressed /api responses) ([#479](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/479)) / 社区索引登记 dsh-gzip（/api 响应 gzip 压缩）
- [community-plugins] register dsh-wsl-bridge in community index ([#474](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/474)) / 在社区索引登记 dsh-wsl-bridge
- [community-plugins] register dsh-mimo-agent-tools in community index ([#473](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/473)) / 在社区索引登记 dsh-mimo-agent-tools
- [community-plugins] register dsh-skill-fuzzy in community index ([#472](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/472)) / 在社区索引登记 dsh-skill-fuzzy
- [settings] optimize the select component under default appearance / 优化默认外观下的 select 组件
- [web-ui-settings] register 6 community plugins (DamonKoy/dsh-plugins) / 登记 6 个社区插件（DamonKoy/dsh-plugins）

### Bug Fixes / 修复

- [pet] clear the pending auto-hide timer on unmount / 卸载时清除待执行的自动隐藏定时器：pointerleave 触发的隐藏定时器可能在组件卸载后触发，导致 CI 中 react-dom 读取 window 报错（window is not defined，慢速 runner 上的 PetSprite.test.tsx），故在卸载时清除 hideTimerRef

- [gallery] deploy the committed styles.js artifact instead of the removed bundles.js / 部署已提交的 styles.js 产物而非已删除的 bundles.js
- [pet] resolve a composed extra atlas to the real file path / 将组合后的附加图集解析为真实文件路径

- [skin-center] stop the layer wipe race and refresh churn ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 消除图层擦除竞态与刷新抖动
- [skin-center] paint the background layer above root backgrounds (v1 layering) ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 将背景图层绘制在根背景之上（v1 分层）
- [skin-center] drop the warning header that rejected non-Latin1 bytes ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 移除拒绝非 Latin-1 字节的警告头
- [skin-center] surface switch failures to the console ([#506](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/issues/506)) / 将切换失败暴露到控制台

本次发布包含 33 项新功能、56 项修复、46 项其他改动。

- [pet] rotating status voice, argument hints, and inner whispers
